acceptance: Logical identities round-trip in one canonical lowercase textual format and reject malformed kind/UUID inputs.
Identity kind remains explicit and opaque; consumers cannot infer ownership, authorization, or mutable state from the identifier.
Git revisions accept only full immutable 40- or 64-hex object IDs and reject branch names, tags, and short hashes.
SHA-256 revisions accept only canonical 64-hex digests.
Identity/revision bindings preserve logical identity separately from immutable exact revision.
Public protocol exports remain provider-neutral and package runtime dependencies remain empty.
Focused tests plus exact-head Ubuntu and Windows repository CI pass.

required: Focused protocol tests for canonical identity/revision round-trip and malformed negative fixtures.
Manifest evidence proving zero runtime dependencies.
Exact-head Ubuntu and Windows repository CI.

minimality.rationale: Implement only the dependency-ordered public identity/revision primitives in the existing @ineractive/protocol package.

requirements: Identity values never encode authorization, ownership, secret material, or mutable state.
Revision values are immutable exact references; mutable branch/tag labels are rejected.

outcome: The public protocol exposes dependency-free, provider-neutral, canonical identity and immutable revision primitives that round-trip deterministically without introducing run/event/finding schemas.
rationale: First public protocol API after canonical SG-000009 framework qualification.

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000010 public identity/revision exports, tests, docs, and evidence; no external side effect or persisted data migration is authorized.

scope_in: Define a canonical opaque logical identity format with explicit kind and UUID payload.
Define immutable revision references for exact Git object identities and SHA-256 content digests.
Provide dependency-free parse/format/validation helpers and typed public protocol exports.
Provide a typed identity-plus-revision binding primitive for exact-state references.
Replace the P00 empty-export placeholder test with public protocol identity/revision contract tests while preserving the zero-runtime-dependency invariant.
scope_out: No Run, Event, Evidence, Finding, ModelTask, DecisionTask, CapabilityRequest, or CapabilityGrant schemas.
No persistence, database, authorization, ownership, timestamps, ordering, or provider-specific semantics.
No ID generation dependency or hidden randomness requirement; this Grain validates and canonicalizes supplied identities.
title: IN-P01-S02-T01 Implement protocol identity and revision primitives
